snippet.title: Total Destruction 2Dee Teaser
snippet.description:
This game has adult references including:
swearing, sexual references, and cartoonish amounts of blood
The tonne is light-hearted but these could end up making some players uncomfortable.
player discretion is advised.

Total Destruction 2Dee is a fast paced platformer where you control Dee as she tries to cause as much mayhem in each level as fast as possible.
Think you have what it takes?

Game created by Sharb (me)
Music by @LOVE_LOVE_PENGUIN 

Support this game and others on my Patreon where I post updates monthly of where everything is and sometimes I'll even publish exclusive patreon builds of the games and toyboxes to mess around with
https://www.patreon.com/sharb
